## Platforms supported

- [ ] macOS
- [ ] Windows
- [ ] Linux
- [ ] Web wrapper only

## Inclusion criteria

- [ ] Public v1 has shipped (not a landing page)
- [ ] Active development in the last 6 months
- [ ] Working homepage with screenshots and install instructions
- [ ] Not already on the list under a different name
- [ ] Not primarily a Chrome extension
- [ ] Not a backend service or library only

## Disclosure

- [ ] I have no affiliation with this product
- [ ] I work on / for this product (please say so — submissions are still welcome, we just want to know)

## Proposed entry

Paste your proposed Markdown entry here, matching the format used in the README:

```markdown

```

## Anything else?

Pricing model, hosting region, license, or anything that would help a reader compare it to neighboring entries.
